001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
005import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
006import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase;
007import com.google.gson.Gson;
008import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
009import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.R;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
015import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo.TrackWithPins;
016import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
017import java.io.IOException;
018import java.io.InputStreamReader;
019import java.io.Reader;
020import java.util.Iterator;
021import java.util.LinkedList;
022import java.util.List;
023import javax.inject.Inject;
024import javax.inject.Provider;
025
026/**
027 * The Preloader class is responsible for preloading and populating a database with
028 * predefined data, such as users, tracks, and pins, during the creation of the database.
029 * It extends RoomDatabase.Callback to hook into the database creation lifecycle.
030 *
031 * This class handles the structured insertion of data:
032 * - Reads predefined JSON data (from resources) for users, tracks, and pins.
033 * - Inserts the data into the database using corresponding DAOs: PinDao, TrackDao, and UserDao.
034 * - Maintains proper relationships between the entities (e.g., associating pins with tracks and users).
035 *
036 * Preloading data is executed asynchronously and off the main thread using RxJava.
037 * Errors during the preloading process result in a runtime exception.
038 */
039public class Preloader extends RoomDatabase.Callback {
040
041
042  private final Context context;
043  private final Provider<PinDao> pinDaoProvider;
044  private final Provider<TrackDao> trackDaoProvider;
045  private final Provider<UserDao> userDaoProvider;
046  private final Gson gson;
047
048  /**
049   * Constructs an instance of the {@code Preloader} class for initializing data access and
050   * serialization dependencies required for the application's operation.
051   *
052   * @param context the application context, used for access to shared application-level resources
053   *                and services.
054   * @param pinDaoProvider the provider for {@link PinDao}, enabling data access operations
055   *                       for {@code Pin} entities.
056   * @param trackDaoProvider the provider for {@link TrackDao}, enabling data access operations
057   *                         for {@code Track} entities.
058   * @param userDaoProvider the provider for {@link UserDao}, enabling data access operations
059   *                        for {@code User} entities.
060   * @param gson the Gson instance used for JSON serialization and deserialization.
061   */
062  @Inject
063  Preloader(@ApplicationContext Context context, Provider<PinDao> pinDaoProvider,
064      Provider<TrackDao> trackDaoProvider, Provider<UserDao> userDaoProvider, Gson gson) {
065    this.context = context;
066    this.pinDaoProvider = pinDaoProvider;
067    this.trackDaoProvider = trackDaoProvider;
068    this.userDaoProvider = userDaoProvider;
069    this.gson = gson;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Handles the creation and initial population of the database when it is first created.
074   * This method preloads pins and tracks data into the database using resources defined
075   * in the application, associates them with a user, and establishes the necessary relationships
076   * between the data entities.
077   *
078   * @param db the {@link SupportSQLiteDatabase} instance representing the database being created.
079   */
080  @Override
081  public void onCreate(@NonNull SupportSQLiteDatabase db) {
082    super.onCreate(db);
083
084    PinDao pinDao = pinDaoProvider.get();
085    TrackDao trackDao = trackDaoProvider.get();
086    UserDao userDao = userDaoProvider.get();
087
088    //Need an input stream
089    try (
090        Reader tracksReader = new InputStreamReader(
091            context.getResources().openRawResource(R.raw.preload_pins_tracks));
092        Reader userReader = new InputStreamReader(
093            context.getResources().openRawResource(R.raw.preload_user))
094    ) {
095      User user = gson.fromJson(userReader, User.class);
096      TrackWithPins[] tracksWithPins = gson.fromJson(tracksReader, TrackWithPins[].class);
097      userDao
098          .insert(user)
099          .flatMap((userId) -> {
100            for (TrackWithPins trackWithPins : tracksWithPins) {
101              trackWithPins.setUserId(userId);
102              for (Pin pin : trackWithPins.getPins()) {
103                pin.setUserId(userId);
104              }
105            }
106            return trackDao.insert(tracksWithPins);
107          })
108          .flatMap((trackIds) -> {
109            List<Pin> pins = new LinkedList<>();
110            Iterator<Long> idIterator = trackIds.iterator();
111            for (TrackWithPins trackWithPins : tracksWithPins) {
112              long trackId = idIterator.next();
113              for (Pin pin : trackWithPins.getPins()) {
114                pin.setTrackId(trackId);
115                pins.add(pin);
116              }
117            }
118            return pinDao.insert(pins);
119          })
120          .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
121          .subscribe();
122    } catch (IOException e) {
123      throw new RuntimeException(e);
124    }
125  }
126}
